stock_name: E TO E TRANS INFRA LTD
headline: E2ERAIL wins Rs 52.85 Cr signalling order from Dhamra Port
summary: E2ERAIL secures Rs 52.85 Cr work order for signalling upgradation at Dhamra Port. Order represents ~14% of FY26 revenue. Recent cash flows remain negative despite revenue growth.

headline: Hec Infra wins Rs 136.29 Cr order from Hindalco
summary: Hec Infra Projects secured a Rs 136.29 crore work order from Hindalco Industries for a 400kV transmission line. This large-scale contract significantly boosts the backlog, covering over 6 quarters of revenue.

headline: Simca Advertising wins Rs 41.3 crore order from Indian Railways
summary: Simca Advertising secures a 5-year advertising contract worth Rs 41.3 crore from Indian Railways Mumbai CST Division. The order significantly boosts the backlog relative to recent inflows, though revenue recognition begins in August 2027.

headline: UHTL wins Rs 1.58 crore order for X-Changers Coolers
summary: United Heat Transfer secures Rs 1.58 crore work order from a domestic equipment firm. Order book coverage remains robust despite recent promoter stake reduction.

headline: CPS Shapers receives Rs 0.94 crore order from Damensch
summary: CPS Shapers secured a Rs 0.94 crore manufacturing order from Damensch Apparel for trunks and briefs. The order represents a small fraction of the recent Rs 18,928 crore inflow in Q2FY27, highlighting a shift in client mix.

headline: Bedmutha Industries wins Rs 19.8 crore order from Nepal Govt
summary: Bedmutha Industries secures Rs 19.8 crore work order for steel wire ropes from Nepal's Dept of Local Infrastructure. Order value is ~4% of avg quarterly revenue. Execution over 19 months.

headline: Nila Infra wins Rs 18.48 Cr work order from Shree Infracon
summary: Nila Infrastructures received a Rs 18.48 crore work order for piling work in Ahmedabad. The order represents ~20% of avg quarterly revenue. Recent cashflows show negative operating CF.

headline: Dynamic Services wins Rs 2.46 Cr order from Barasat Govt Medical College
summary: Dynamic Services & Security disclosed a Rs 2.4584832 crore work order from Barasat Government Medical College for cleaning personnel. This follows a recent Rs 1.35 crore order from ESI Hospital.

headline: Innovators Facade wins Rs 59.37 Cr order from Aditya Birla
summary: Innovators Facade Systems secures Rs 59.37 Cr facade work order from Aditya Birla Real Estate for Birla Niyaara, Mumbai. Order represents ~26% of FY26 quarterly revenue. Backlog conversion remains key focus.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins Rs 5.74 Cr order from North Central Railway
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a Rs 5.74 crore work order for CMS crossings. This adds to a robust backlog with 19.63 quarters of coverage, though FY26 revenue declined YoY.

headline: Raksan Transformers wins Rs 24.75 Cr order
summary: Raksan Transformers received a significant order worth Rs 24.75 crore from an EPC company for distribution transformers, disclosed on Nov 20, 2026.

headline: DevIT wins Rs 2.31 Cr order from Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation
summary: Dev Information Technology secured a Rs 2.31 crore work order for property tax system redesign. Order book covers 7 quarters of revenue. Q3 inflow decelerated to Rs 34.16 Cr.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins Rs 2758 crore metro order
summary: Ashoka Buildcon secured a Rs 2758.31 crore mega order from Rajasthan Metro Rail Corporation for elevated viaducts and stations. This adds to its recent Rs 1465 crore NHAI win, boosting Q3FY27 inflows.

headline: Apana Logistics wins Rs 14.8 Cr order from Domestic Logistics Co
summary: Apana Logistics secured a Rs 14.8 crore 5-year contract for container handling in Rajasthan. This follows recent inflows, boosting the SME's backlog significantly.

headline: Megamont wins Rs 15.59 Cr sunflower oil supply order
summary: Megamont secured a confirmed Rs 15.59 Cr order from Frigorifico Allana for crude sunflower oil supply. This adds to its recent inflow, though total disclosed backlog remains low relative to TTM revenue.

headline: Virtual Galaxy Infotech wins Rs 3.65 Cr order from Bhandara Bank
summary: Virtual Galaxy Infotech secures Rs 3.65 crore SD-WAN and Cyber Security order from Bhandara District Central Co-operative Bank. This follows Q2FY27 inflows of Rs 6.98 Cr, supporting backlog conversion.

headline: Ameya Precision wins Rs 1.12 Cr order from Sulzer Pumps Mexico
summary: Ameya Precision Engineers secured a Rs 1.12 crore international supply order from Sulzer Pumps México. This significant contract, disclosed on Nov 19, 2026, involves pump components with completion due by Feb 2027.

headline: Anondita Medicare wins Rs 17.46 lakh order from R.K. Corporation
summary: Anondita Medicare secures a Rs 17.46 lakh supply order from Bangladesh-based R.K. Corporation for condoms. This small-ticket export order complements a robust Q3FY27 inflow of Rs 570 crore, primarily driven by large government tenders.

headline: Jupiter Wagons bags Rs 128.61 Cr order from JSW Rail
summary: Jupiter Wagons secured a Rs 128.61 crore order from JSW (South) Rail Logistics for 302 BFNSM1 wagons. This adds to its growing order book, now exceeding Rs 4,454 crore across recent quarters.

headline: Ems wins Rs 13.96 Cr NHAI order for Assam fee plaza
summary: Ems Limited secured a Rs 13.96 crore work order from NHAI for user fee collection in Assam. This significant contract adds to its order book, which currently stands at Rs 294,809.39 Cr, implying massive backlog coverage relative to quarterly revenue.

headline: Rossell Techsys wins Rs 50 crore order from overseas space client
summary: Confirmed order for wire harnesses. Book-to-bill low due to limited disclosure. Execution capacity strained by negative cashflow and high leverage.

headline: Newgen wins Rs 17.46 crore order from CreditAccess Grameen
summary: Newgen Software Technologies secured a Rs 17.46 crore loan origination solution contract from CreditAccess Grameen. This adds to a Rs 236.10 crore disclosed order book, representing 0.55 quarters of revenue coverage.

headline: Dhruv Consultancy wins Rs 8.15 crore order from MPRDC
summary: Dhruv Consultancy secured a Rs 8.15 crore consultancy order for the Western Bhopal Bypass. This adds to a Rs 497.85 crore order book, though recent quarters show negative margins and cash outflows.

headline: Susan Electricals wins Rs 148.9 Cr order for HT Cables
summary: Susan Electricals secured a Rs 148.9 crore confirmed work order for HT Cables and MVCC. This inflow contrasts with zero disclosed orders in the prior three quarters, signaling a potential shift in order velocity.

headline: Viviana Power Tech wins Rs 124 Cr order from DHBVNL
summary: Viviana Power Tech secures Rs 124 crore work order from DHBVNL for 11 KV feeder infrastructure. Order book coverage stands at 5.40 quarters, with strong historical revenue growth.

headline: Dilip Buildcon wins Rs 419.47 crore order from GMRL
summary: DBL secures Rs 419.47 crore work order for Gurgaon Metro depot. Order book coverage stands at 4.54 quarters. Q2FY27 inflow was Rs 7221.39 crore, showing strong momentum.

headline: BMW Ventures wins Rs 9.07 Cr order from Neelachal Ispat
summary: BMW Ventures secured a Rs 9.07 crore fabrication and supply order from Neelachal Ispat Nigam Limited. This adds to a strong Q2FY27 inflow of Rs 97.92 crore, driven by large TMT steel contracts.

headline: Highway Infrastructure bags Rs 198.31 Cr CPWD order
summary: Highway Infrastructure Ltd secured a Rs 198.31 crore order from CPWD for CISF battalion infrastructure in Madhya Pradesh, adding to its recent NHAI wins.

headline: 3I Infotech wins Rs 24.48 Cr IT services order from Indian bank
summary: 3I Infotech secured a Rs 24.48 crore facility management contract from a domestic banking institution. The order adds to a total disclosed book of Rs 328.24 Cr, representing 1.73 quarters of coverage.

headline: Coal India receives Rs 1200 crore LoI for Rare Earth Magnet Project
summary: CIL declared L2 bidder for Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet facility. Order is a Letter of Intent, not a confirmed work order. Revenue recognition pending formal contract.

headline: Rmc Switchgears wins Rs 18.51 Cr order from Kryfs Power
summary: Rmc Switchgears secured a Rs 18.51 crore work order from Kryfs Power Components for FSP and meter boxes. This adds to a modest backlog, with book-to-bill at 0.10x based on recent disclosures.

headline: Nbcc wins Rs 84.87 crore order from Ravenshaw University
summary: Nbcc secures Rs 84.87 crore work order for construction works at Ravenshaw University, Cuttack. This adds to a robust order book of Rs 7,778.44 Cr, representing 2.29 quarters of coverage.

stock_name: East India Drums and Barrels M
headline: East India Drums wins Rs 33.99 Cr order from IOCL
summary: East India Drums & Barrels Mfg. secured a Rs 33.99 crore work order from Indian Oil Corporation Limited for bitumen drums. This adds to recent inflows, though quarterly order velocity has decelerated compared to Q1FY27.

headline: Gpt Infraprojects wins Rs 120.95 Cr order from NE Railway
summary: Gpt Infraprojects secures Rs 120.95 Cr work order for Electronic Interlocking systems. Total disclosed order book stands at Rs 2794.19 Cr, providing 8.58 quarters of revenue coverage.

headline: GAIL awards Rs 13.93 Cr pipeline work to SME firm
summary: SME company secures Rs 13.93 crore order from GAIL for LMC/CGD pipelines. Order book coverage is limited given zero reported TTM revenue. Execution capacity and cash conversion remain key watchpoints.

headline: Aurionpro bags Rs 100 cr order for AI data centre
summary: Aurionpro Solutions secures Rs 100 crore order from Global Hyperscaler for MEP works in first AI-ready data centre. Engagement spans nine months.

headline: Adani Energy wins Rs 500 Cr order from Bihar STU
summary: Adani Energy Solutions secured a Rs 500 crore transmission work order from Bihar State Transmission Utility. The project involves GIS substations and transmission lines, adding to a Rs 13,200 crore backlog.

headline: Aptech wins Rs 2.85 crore skilling order from State body
summary: Aptech Limited secured a Rs 2.85 crore contract from an autonomous body under a State Government to conduct Skilling Course training programs in Q3 FY 2026-27.

headline: Supreme Power wins Rs 6.25 Cr transformer order
summary: Supreme Power Equipment secured a Rs 6.25 crore work order for power transformers from a Hyderabad firm. This adds to a Rs 211.24 crore order book, covering ~3.5 quarters of revenue.

headline: Abha Power wins Rs 1.16 Cr casting order from railway manufacturer
summary: Abha Power And Steel secures Rs 1.16 crore order for castings from a reputed railway-sector manufacturer. The deal adds to a steady inflow of small-ticket contracts, with Q3FY27 inflows reaching Rs 4.04 crore.

headline: Hd Fire Protect wins Rs 6 Cr order for fire protection equipment
summary: Hd Fire Protect secured a Rs 6 crore work order for fire protection equipment supply. This represents ~5% of avg quarterly revenue. Execution timeline is 10-12 weeks.

headline: Seamec wins Rs 10.77 cr order from Posh India Offshore
summary: Seamec secures Rs 10.77 crore subsea installation order. Book-to-bill is 0.14x. Q2FY27 revenue OPM dropped to 19.31% from 41.74% in Q1FY27.

headline: Indo Smc wins Rs 18.25 Cr order from Ahmedabad supplier
summary: Indo Smc secures Rs 18.25 crore order for FSP/MSP supply. Book-to-bill context pending full data. Execution timeline set for 120 days.

headline: Om Power wins Rs 46.57 Cr order from GETCO
summary: Om Power Transmission secures Rs 46.57 crore work order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation for substation works. This adds to a robust Q3FY27 inflow of Rs 310.06 crore, with strong revenue growth trends visible in recent financials.

headline: Titagarh Rail Systems wins Rs 65.38 crore order from CLW
summary: Confirmed order for traction motors. Book-to-bill low at 0.00x. Q2FY27 OPM improved to 13.41%. Execution ends Dec 2027.

headline: Brahmaputra Infra wins Rs 16.06 Cr NHAI order for NH-27 rectification
summary: Confirmed work order from NHAI Guwahati. Order book covers 5.46 quarters of revenue. Q2FY27 revenue up 9.1% QoQ with OPM at 23.26%.

headline: Advait Energy wins Rs 130.48 Cr GETCO order
summary: Advait Energy Transitions secured a Rs 130.48 crore work order from GETCO for line reconductoring. The order represents 61% of avg quarterly revenue, boosting the backlog to 3.90 quarters coverage.

headline: Hirect wins Rs 136.26 Cr order from CLW for traction motors
summary: Hirect secured a Rs 136.26 Cr confirmed work order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for traction motors. The deal boosts the backlog to Rs 566.76 Cr, covering ~2 quarters of revenue.

headline: Sharika wins Rs 3.49 Cr LED lighting order from Punjab EDA
summary: Sharika Enterprises secures Rs 3.49 crore work order for SPV street lighting in Punjab. Order book covers 1.82 quarters of revenue. Recent quarters show margin recovery despite annual losses.

headline: Positron Energy wins Rs 40 Cr RLNG supply order from Domestic PSU
summary: Positron Energy secured a Rs 40 crore spot RLNG supply order. Book-to-bill ratio stands at 3.6x based on recent inflows. Q3FY27 order inflow reached Rs 152.21 crore, showing strong momentum.

headline: Dhabriya Polywood secures Rs 17.69 Cr order from M3M Group
summary: Dhabriya Polywood has received a work order worth Rs 17.69 crore from M3M Group for Aluminum Doors and Windows façade. The contract has an execution period of 18 months.

headline: Refex wins Rs 28 Cr order for Pond Ash utilization
summary: Refex Industries secured a Rs 28 crore work order from a Major Power Producer for Pond Ash utilization. The deal adds to its Rs 921.93 Cr backlog, covering 1.15 quarters of revenue.

headline: Pace Digitek wins Rs 19.4 Cr BESS order from Insolare
summary: Confirmed order for BESS supply and AMC. Book-to-bill at 4.3x. Q3FY27 inflow Rs 5741 Cr.

headline: Monarch Surveyors wins Rs 34.94 Cr order
summary: Monarch Surveyors & Engg. Consultants secured a Rs 34.94 crore contract from Southern Railway for survey and investigation assignments in Kerala.

headline: Ameenji Rubber wins Rs 21.44 Cr order from Eastern Railway
summary: Confirmed work order for rubber pads. High order inflow in Q3FY27. Revenue growth of 31% in FY26, but margins compressed. Watch execution capacity.

headline: Annu Projects wins Rs 3.82 Cr work order from IOCL
summary: Annu Projects secured a Rs 3.82 Cr work order from Indian Oil Corporation Limited for OFC laying works. The order represents 4.1% of average quarterly revenue, with total disclosed backlog covering 0.19 quarters.

headline: Aurobindo Pharma's Apitoria Unit-6 gets USFDA VAI status
summary: Aurobindo Pharma's Apitoria Pharma Unit-6 received a VAI classification from the USFDA following 3 inspection observations, with the inspection closed and EIR received.

headline: Cohance Lifesciences gets EIR with VAI for Shamshabad
summary: The USFDA has concluded its inspection of Cohance Lifesciences' Shamshabad facility and issued an Establishment Inspection Report with Voluntary Action Indicated classification.

headline: Permanent Magnets subsidiary to inaugurate NdFeB facility
summary: Quantum Magnetics Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Permanent Magnets Ltd, will inaugurate its NdFeB Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Facility in Vasai, Maharashtra on December 8, 2026.

headline: Shayona Engineering delays H1FY27 results due to auditor change
summary: Shayona Engineering Ltd notified BSE of a delay in submitting unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The delay stems from the resignation of statutory auditors and the subsequent transition to new auditors.

headline: Suprajit Engineering seeks shareholder nod for Steffen Berns
summary: Suprajit Engineering has initiated a postal ballot to appoint Dr. Steffen Berns as Independent Director. Voting opens November 23, 2026.

headline: Veejay Lakshmi promoter group acquires 33,480 shares via inheritance
summary: J Anand HUF, a member of the promoter group, acquired 33,480 equity shares of Veejay Lakshmi Engineering Works through transmission/inheritance, raising its holding to 0.66%.
